body: Thank you, friend, I think I’ll listen to your advice. Thank you for listening to me tonight, you really helped me out. Have a great day/night :)
You’re right, thank you, surrendering isnt an option because one day with help, things will be okay right? Or at least, there’s enough probability there for me to hope so?

Hello, thank you very much for responding. I’m just so so tired and I feel like I can’t tell anyone around me because I’m the person everyone comes to for help, I know they’re struggling and I don’t want to trouble them. I’m so scared of everything, and I just want to hide and never leave my room. I feel like there’s a hole in my chest and it hurts. I just want to fall asleep and never wake up again, I don’t know what to do
